items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: they played for the Shripmans, and it's their territory

ctx.x: Wow! I can remember some of the black bands that Chick Webb and Cab Calloway and Coleman Hawkins were in -- man, if you go up to New England, look out for that Mel Hallis' band, becuase they had some bad cats in there. They flew every big name band down there, it was always a band contest when you ran into Mel Hallis' band. Now excuse me, Cliff, it's your life, you tell it.

No, I'm just a little bit later on -- because they were all around, the territory bands, they called them territory bands because they played for the Shripmans, and it's their territory, but there were lots of colleges to play in then and ballrooms -- oh, just ballrooms galore, all over -- those were the days of contact dancing.
And of course, Glenn Miller came along as a territory band.
